source_title: First and Last Men: Escape from the Solar Cul-de-sac
about: Institutional deadlock forces a mediator faction to broker power while influence remains a conserved pool.

characters.name: The Counter Archivist
characters.description: A patient anti-institution that keeps a mirror-ledger of power: it cancels quiet influence with evidence, leaks, and paradox-proof memory.

characters.name: The Mediator
characters.description: A broker of uneasy settlements who tracks public sentiment and timing windows.
